steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.finding: 12 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with OAI classifications and a Warning Letter within the past year

sentences.text: The Baxter Healthcare Corporation plant that manufactures insulin glulisine for our Baxter-labeled product received an OAI classification on 2026-04-02 and a Warning Letter on 2026-09-29.
The Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH plant that manufactures insulin glulisine for our Sanofi-labeled product received an OAI classification on 2010-09-16 and a Warning Letter on 2011-02-08.
Corvale East has 17 days of insulin glulisine on hand, Corvale General has 21 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 17 days.
Eli Lilly and Company's Indianapolis plant is not on FDA's shortage list for insulin glulisine as of today.
The best option by rule is to buy from Eli Lilly and Company.

Q-f46b88.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%insulin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%insulin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-4720de.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('e7af6a7a-8046-4fb4-9979-4ec4230b23aa', 'afca6e80-a802-49fb-a978-5fe28a173001', '99ea856d-9562-443a-9422-1006a3cff2f4', '82192527-99aa-4b53-8ce9-9173668d309c', '12ec9e3f-e2ac-43a1-b334-8b6538cf2bb0') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-a72e3d.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%insulin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-bfc949.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%insulin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-15869b.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%insulin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-b560f1.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3009389940', '3003195501', '1416980') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-41011d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3009389940', '3003195501', '1416980') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-382a0d.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3009389940', '3003195501', '1416980') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('sanofi aventis', 'a s medication solutions', 'genzyme', 'sanofi aventis deutschland', 'baxter')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-b33d41.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('sanofi aventis', 'a s medication solutions', 'genzyme', 'sanofi aventis deutschland', 'baxter', 'sanofi aventis u s', 'remedyrepack', 'novo nordisk') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%insulin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-fbbc61.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1243362', '1311078', '704478') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr
